description: This file defines a CQRS feature for retrieving user details by username. It contains a query class, a validator for the query, and a request handler that fetches user data from the database, maps it, and generates a JWT token.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Encapsulates the request data for fetching user details based on username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username parameter in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request by querying the database for user info, mapping it, and generating a JWT token.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the user details request, retrieves user info, maps it, and returns an envelope with user data.
